## Summary

Added a backend endpoint `POST /items/{id}/duplicate` that creates a copy of an item owned by the current user.

**Implementation details:**
- The endpoint is at `backend/app/api/routes/items.py:99-120`
- The duplicate has a new UUID and timestamp (auto-generated), but copies the title and description from the original
- The copy is owned by the current user making the request
- Permission checks: non-superusers can only duplicate items they own; superusers can duplicate any item
- Returns the duplicated ItemPublic model

**Tests:**
- `test_duplicate_item`: verifies successful duplication by superuser
- `test_duplicate_item_not_found`: 404 when item doesn't exist
- `test_duplicate_item_not_enough_permissions`: 403 when non-superuser tries to duplicate someone else's item

All 14 item tests pass (11 existing + 3 new).
